title: Add the bee hook activity verb that records per-session agent state
action: Create packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/activity.rs and register it: in hooks/mod.rs add `pub mod activity;` beside the other hook modules (the `pub mod tools_logger;` block near the top), add "activity" to HOOK_NAMES (the array is typed `[&str; 9]` — bump the length), and add the match arm next to the tools-logger arm in the dispatcher; add "hook activity" to router.rs PORTED (the list that starts with "hook tools-logger"). Model the handler on tools_logger.rs `pub fn run(argv: &[String], stdin: &str) -> Outcome`: read_hook_context("activity", argv, stdin); no root -> exit 0; bee_installed(root) and hook_enabled(root, "activity") gates; any error -> log_crash(...) AND one line appended to <root>/.bee/logs/hook-activity.log (cap the log at 256 KiB by truncating to the last half when it exceeds); always ExitCode::SUCCESS (per D1). Read session_id, hook_event_name, cwd, tool_name, tool_use_id, notification_type, message, reason from ctx.payload; read HERDR_PANE_ID from the environment as pane. Mapping per D3: UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure -> working; PermissionRequest -> blocked (record tool_name and tool_use_id); Notification: notification_type permission_prompt -> blocked, agent_needs_input -> waiting_input, idle_prompt or agent_completed -> idle, anything else -> no transition; Stop -> idle; SessionEnd with reason not clear/resume -> exited (clear/resume -> no transition). Any other hook_event_name (SubagentStop included) -> no transition, exit 0. Sticky rule per D3: when the recorded state is blocked, a PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure changes it only if the payload tool_use_id equals the recorded one, or — when no tool_use_id was recorded — the tool_name equals; otherwise the blocked state stays and the event is NOT appended as a transition. When the recorded state is waiting_input, only UserPromptSubmit or Stop (turn boundaries) or an exited/blocked event change it. Store per D2: the session record is <control_root>/.bee/sessions/<session_id>.json (control_root from ctx, fall back to root); load it fail-open like state_sync.rs read_session_failopen; if absent create a minimal record {id, started_at: now, transcript_path (from payload if present), workspace_id from ctx if cheap else "main", source: "activity"}; set record.activity = {state, event, tool_name?, tool_use_id?, at: now_iso(), pane?, cwd}; write with the state_sync write_json_atomic_retry helper (use the sessions store lock the same way heartbeat_session does, single attempt, fail-open). Append the same object plus session_id to <sessions dir>/<session_id>.activity.jsonl with fsutil::append_jsonl, then if the file has more than 50 lines rewrite it atomically to the last 50. Only a real state change (or a blocked->blocked with a different tool_use_id) is a transition; a working->working repeat refreshes activity.at and activity.event in the json but is NOT appended to the jsonl. waiting_on per D5: on a transition INTO waiting_input call the workflow_store set function (kind "question", subject = message or "agent needs input") and INTO blocked (kind "gate", subject = tool_name or message); resolve the target with resolve_waiting_on_target(root, "hook activity", None, false, Some(session_id)) and run rebuild_lane_projection + rebuild_state_projection after a lane write exactly as waiting_on.rs does; record a marker field activity.waiting_on_set_by_hook = true. Never overwrite a live mark whose kind is gate or question that the hook did not set (check waiting_on_is_live and the marker). On a turn boundary (UserPromptSubmit or Stop) clear the mark only when the marker is set, then drop the marker. Tests: unit tests inside activity.rs over a tempdir for every row of the plan.md test matrix (happy, sticky blocked vs different tool_use_id, SessionEnd clear/resume no-op, 51st transition trims to 50, missing record created, agent-set mark survives a hook blocked); add "activity" to the HOOKS list in tests/hook_contracts.rs so the adversarial-stdin matrix covers it. Commit with subject in imperative mood and trailer `cell: aah-1`.

truths: bee hook activity with a PermissionRequest payload writes activity.state=blocked into .bee/sessions/<id>.json and one row into <id>.activity.jsonl
a PostToolUse payload with a different tool_use_id leaves state=blocked and appends nothing
empty, garbage, and 2 MB stdin exit 0 with a line in .bee/logs/hook-activity.log
a hook-set waiting_on mark is cleared at the next UserPromptSubmit; an agent-set mark is never touched by the hook

artifacts.substantive: the activity handler: payload parse, D3 state machine with sticky rules, D2 store writes with atomic trim, D5 waiting_on set/clear, unit tests

key_links: activity.rs writes through the same atomic session write path state_sync uses
prohibitions: no change to any other hook's behavior
never a non-zero exit from this hook
no hand-rolled JSON writer — use fsutil

trace.outcome: bee hook activity records per-session agent state (D1/D2/D3/D5) with sticky blocked/waiting_input and a hook-owned waiting mark
deviations: The cell's verify string chained two filters in one cargo invocation, which cargo rejects; ran cargo test ... hooks::activity and cargo test ... --test hook_contracts, then the wider `hook` filter, all green.

Widened `mod store` and `mod waiting_on` to pub(crate) in verbs/state_group/mod.rs (one word each, no behavior) so the hook can call the SAME waiting_on setters the CLI verb uses instead of becoming a second writer; file reserved under w-aah-1.

Blocked->blocked counts as a transition only when the NEW payload carries a tool_use_id that differs — an id-less Notification right after a PermissionRequest would otherwise append a duplicate row for one block.
